fusions.name: Tuft Fling
fusions.desc: Flings a clump of matted fur that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 40% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Matted Fence
fusions.desc: Strings a 5-tile line of matted fur ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 11 damage to each one it catches and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Raised Hackles
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage, up to 4 blows, and holds for 6 seconds. Your armour rises by 8% while you carry it.

fusions.name: Winter Coat
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you have 10% frost resistance.
